'''Rogoe's stronghold''' was a prison camp on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] owned by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]]. Boss [[Hoxie]] of [[Otoh Raban]] was imprisoned here until he was [[Battle of the Forest Cities|rescued]] by Boss [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]].
